content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

Before signing the agreement, I'd like to raise one point for us to adjust together.

- The relevant clause requires the Consultant to perform any additional services beyond those specifically mentioned in the agreement, to the extent they are necessary to maintain the Company's best interests. In plain terms, this would make the fixed monthly fee cover an unlimited, client-defined scope with no change-order process and no additional compensation. A constructive modification would be to limit the Consultant's services to the scope described in Section A of the agreement, with any work beyond that scope subject to a mutually agreed written change order specifying the additional work and any applicable additional compensation.

Please let me know if we can work through this before signing. I'm happy to discuss it whenever is convenient for you.

Best regards,
